item.title: IAEA looking into Iran’s report that Natanz nuclear site hit in strikes
item.summary: Human rights organizations say they fear Iran will carry out mass executions after the public hangings this week of three men who took place in anti-government protests.

item.title: Trump administration lifts sanctions on millions of barrels of Iranian oil
item.summary: The Treasury Department’s authorization of the sale of Iranian crude already at sea is likely to provide revenue for Iran’s war effort against the U.S.

item.title: The Middle East celebrates Eid and Nowruz under the shadow of war
item.summary: Missile exchanges have jarred with the spirit of the holidays underway across the region.

item.title: 4 women killed in West Bank are first Palestinian deaths in Iran war
item.summary: They were at a salon getting their nails done for Eid al-Fitr. It was unclear who fired the missile.

item.title: Hezbollah is bombing northern Israel again. Residents are staying put.
item.summary: Rather than evacuation, Israel’s defense minister said the mission now is “to protect northern communities against raids and anti-tank fire.”

item.title: Iran hits Gulf energy sites, escalating war, as U.S. mulls sanctions rollback
item.summary: As attacks rattled markets, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the Trump administration might lift restrictions on Iranian oil already loaded onto vessels.

item.title: Cuban oil crisis? Russian tanker could challenge U.S. blockade.
item.summary: A Kremlin spokesman said the Russian government is discussing “possible options for assisting Cuba in the difficult situation it finds itself in.”

item.title: K-pop stars BTS thrill Seoul with comeback concert after military service
item.summary: The South Korean megastars thrilled tens of thousands of fans with their first concert in nearly four years following a break for military service and solo careers.

item.title: U.S.-Israeli rift widens over potential endgame in Iran
item.summary: Israel’s assault on the world’s largest natural gas deposit has renewed tensions between the two allies’ end goals in Iran.

item.title: Cuba rejects ‘shameless’ U.S. Embassy request to bring in fuel
item.summary: An effective U.S. oil blockade has worsened the island’s energy crisis. The U.S. Embassy in Havana, too, is feeling the effects.
